## Read data

Read data file produced by compiling `01_prepare_data.Rmd`
```{r read_data}
d0 <- get_derived_data()
```

Read data file produced by compiling `02_derive_variables.Rmd`
```{r}
analysis_data <- get_analysis_data()
```


## ID x date_var x c_visit recorded outside windows

```{r visits_not_in_window}
# Assign state for all observations of randomized individuals
all_windows <- get_windows(data = d0[!is.na(rand_id)])
all_windows <- merge(d0[, .(ID, c_visit, date, date_var)],
                     all_windows)

# Get one row per ID x date_var x c_visit (except day0) recorded outside window
cols <- c("ID", "date", "date_var", "c_visit", "d_day0", "n_days_from_target","state")
visits_not_in_window <- unique(
  all_windows[, ..cols]
  )[state == "outside_window" & c_visit != "day0"][, !'state']

# Write to excel file
setorder(visits_not_in_window, ID, c_visit, date)
ll <- c(list("all"=visits_not_in_window), split(visits_not_in_window, by="ID"))
write_xlsx(x=ll, path = paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(),
                               "_visits_not_in_window.xlsx"))
head(visits_not_in_window)
```


## MADRS-10 subject progress

Distribution of days from target on madras total10 ratings by visit:
```{r madrs_windows}
dt_madrs <- analysis_data[variable == "madrs" & part == "total10"]
stopifnot(dt_madrs[, .N, .(ID, f_visit)][, all(N == 1)])

split(
  droplevels(dt_madrs[!is.na(date) & f_visit %in% c("day4","day7","day14","day28"),
                      .N, keyby=.(f_visit, n_days_from_target,
                                  in_window = 1*(state == "in_window"))]), 
      by="f_visit"
  )
```

Evaluate the visit window status of the MADRS-10 total score for all randomized 
subjects across all visits.

```{r mk_madrs_subject_progress}
## Tabulate visit by state:
tab <- dt_madrs[, .N, keyby=.(n_target, f_visit, has_no_date = 1*is.na(date), state)]
tab

# Split data by state
setorder(dt_madrs, state, -n_target, n_days_from_target)
split_data <- split(dt_madrs[, .(ID, f_visit, d_day0, trt, n_target,
                                 d_target, d_lwr,d_upr, d_today, date,
                                 state, n_days_from_target)], 
                    by="state")


## Save tables to file:
write_xlsx(c(list(tab=tab), split_data),
          path=paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(), 
                      "_status_for_all_visits.xlsx"))
```
